title: Polymer Chemistry Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the location of the unpaired electron on the radical because this is where the reaction takes place."
The active center is the location of the unpaired electron on the radical because this is where the reaction takes place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as ability of rubber to exhibit very large deformability with complete recoverability."
Rubber Elasticity is defined as ability of rubber to exhibit very large deformability with complete recoverability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the energy a sample can absorb before it breaks."
The toughness is a measure of the energy a sample can absorb before it breaks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in paints and adhesives as well as composites."
Similarly epoxides are used in paints and adhesives as well as composites.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a two-unit degree course for all students offering Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) Chemistry."
Polymer chemistry is a two-unit degree course for all students offering Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) Chemistry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to replace rubbers for improved sound/vibration dampening."
The soft urethanes are used to replace rubbers for improved sound/vibration dampening.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means elapsed time under load, rate of loading, rate of deformation etc."
Time factor means elapsed time under load, rate of loading, rate of deformation etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means molar mass, branching, crosslinking and crystallinity."
Structure means molar mass, branching, crosslinking and crystallinity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the strain on a sample when it breaks."
The elongation-to- break is the strain on a sample when it breaks.
fib: ______ is a useful technique to study the polymerization and composition of filled polymers.
Thermogravimetry
Thermogravimetry is a useful technique to study the polymerization and composition of filled polymers.
______ means types of additives, defects, blending and orientation.
Nature
Nature means types of additives, defects, blending and orientation.
______ is a curious material because, unlike metals, strain energy is stored thermally.
Rubber
Rubber is a curious material because, unlike metals, strain energy is stored thermally.
______ may be defined as the simultaneous polymerization of two or more monomers to form a polymer containing both or all the monomers.
Copolymerization
Copolymerization may be defined as the simultaneous polymerization of two or more monomers to form a polymer containing both or all the monomers.
______ is the slope of stress-strain curve.
Young's modulus
Young's modulus is the slope of stress-strain curve.
______ is used extensively in many applications and products, as is synthetic rubber.
Natural rubber
Natural rubber is used extensively in many applications and products, as is synthetic rubber.
______ is a complex procedure and can take place in a variety of ways.
Polymer synthesis
Polymer synthesis is a complex procedure and can take place in a variety of ways.

negative Gibbs free energy change
A negative Gibbs free energy change means that solution process is thermodynamically feasible.
